name: Kyverna Therapeutics, Inc.
summary: Kyverna Therapeutics, Inc., a late-stage biopharmaceutical company, focuses on developing cell therapies for patients with autoimmune diseases. Its lead product candidate is KYV-101, an autologous CD19 CAR T-cell product candidate for the treatment of stiff person syndrome, myasthenia gravis, and autoimmune diseases. The company is also developing KYV-102, an autologous CD19 CAR T-cell product candidate with whole blood rapid manufacturing; and KYV-201, an allogeneic CD19 CAR T-cell product candidate. It has a license and collaboration agreement with Intellia Therapeutics, Inc. to research and develop an allogeneic CD19-directed CAR cell therapy product. The company was formerly known as BAI…
